news.title: Meet the 2026 Alumni Achievement and Horizon Award Winners
news.summary_en: Each year, Alumni Achievement Awards are presented to Augustana University alumni who have made outstanding contributions to their fields of endeavor, communities and/or churches. The Horizon Award recognizes young alumni who have graduated within the last 15 years and quickly demonstrated outstanding vocational achievement and provided faithful service to their community and/or church. news.title: Augustana Ranked Top 5 Regional University by U.S. News & World Report
news.summary_en: Augustana has been ranked as the No. 5 Regional University in the Midwest by U.S. News & World Report’s2027 Best College Rankings. U.S. News & World Report also ranked Augustana No. 6 in Best Value across the region.
